acceptance: The nightly run records the crossing date once, on the crossing invoice's business date; the fee starts on the first day of the month after crossedOn + 90 days (June 15 gives Oct 1).
Jan 1 re-test exempts the fee all year when the prior year was under $500,000 and applies it all year when over.
A return after delivery refunds everything except the fee line; a pre-delivery cancel voids the fee and records a credit for the next DR 1786; an exchange adds no new fee.
rdfHandling cannot change once any fee applies, and the setup screen says so.
Use tax starts each year ANNUAL and switches to MONTHLY only when that year passes the threshold, with a To do on the reset.
Filing-frequency advice appears once per year (benefits) and in December (fixed); one tap confirms the new frequency from the next period.
An expired certificate produces a To do with the DR 0715 or DR 5002 ask and a drafted message; a back-dated certificate credits the tax charged since validFrom without changing past bills.
The license defaults to 12/31/2027 from the rule and rolls to the next odd year on renewal, with a reminder at the timing point.
ci green at the exact head; every review comment read.

gates.affected: returnShopSale refunds the delivery fee, which the spec calls a legal error; no paid-before-delivery cancel path exists for shop sales.
gates.remedy: Delivered-vs-not branch in returnShopSale plus a Decisions question filed for what before delivery means for a shop sale; build the most likely answer (cancel is unpaid and never handed over, return is paid and handed over).
gates.reopen: A paid-before-delivery cancel path is found in the code or the CPA answers otherwise.

gates.affected: No stored approval gate exists for the fee switch; the fee decision is recomputed live from settings.
gates.remedy: New RetailDeliveryFeeSwitch model holding the prepared switch and the owner approval, plus an APPLY_OFFICIAL_RATE-style Today action.
gates.reopen: A switch approval is recorded without a startsOn date, or approval state is found in another store.

gates.affected: rdfNewBusinessStartsOn rounds the start date by filing frequency, contradicting the statute formula for QUARTERLY and ANNUAL accounts.
gates.remedy: Replace with rdfQualifiedEndsOn (first day of the month after crossedOn + 90 days) and update the three call sites.
gates.reopen: A QUARTERLY or ANNUAL account start date is computed with the old formula.

invariants: Issued bills never change; a late fee switch never rewrites signed or billed history.
The fee is never charged twice for one sale; a replacement sale carries no new fee.
A return after delivery keeps the fee owed; the customer refund excludes the fee line.
Use tax returns to ANNUAL on Jan 1; the app never changes a filing frequency itself.
Every automatic switch is prepared and dated by the app and approved by Chris on To do before it changes a bill.
Money is integer cents; times stored UTC, shown America/Denver.
next: TFA-3 — watching official sources and updating itself (depends on TFA-1; TFA-2 complete).
outcome: The tax autopilot prepares and dates every switch, Chris approves each one on To do, and the fee, use tax, filing frequency, certificates and license follow the statute without ever rewriting an issued bill.
